summary: Regression test on /journal after addition of new 'Start Here: A Curated Reading Path' section. New section validated end-to-end (12 cards, jump anchor, navigation, images), zero console errors on all 10 main pages, no mobile horizontal overflow at 390x844, backend smoke tests all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: All previous code review concerns from iterations 19-22 remain addressed. The new section in Journal.jsx (lines 239-345) and curatedReadingPath.js are clean: proper data-testid coverage, accessible anchor, lazy image loading, decoupled data layer.

Minor non-blocking note: Journal.jsx is now 757 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Future refactor could extract the Start-Here section and other large sections into sub-components, but this is not urgent.
